answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a copper-weighted stake in a shared vault before it may attest or earn: the stake is bonded to one verifiable identity and slashed when that identity signs conflicting claims. Because a zephyr of cheap new identities cannot reproduce the locked collateral or the history tied to it, creating a thousand fake agents costs a thousand times the bond instead of nothing, while honest agents keep earning against their single deposit.
